call_points.text: Gear division open order book reached ₹1,056 Cr (+37% YoY) at end-Q2FY27.
MHE division open order book reached ₹579 Cr (+27.3% YoY) as of September 30, 2026.
MHE division full-year EBIT margin guided in the range of 22% to 24%.
Gear division EBIT margin target reiterated at 20% to 22%.
Lead banker released collateral security for working capital limits, removing hypothecation on properties and plant.
Current capacity utilization stands at ~60%, with ongoing de-bottlenecking of specific machine constraints.
Long-term revenue target of ₹5,000 Cr by FY30 with 50% export mix reconfirmed.
Consolidated open order book stood at ₹1,635 Cr as of September 30, 2026, up approximately 33% YoY.
EBITDA margin expanded by 140 bps YoY to 23.1% in Q2FY27 supported by higher contribution from the gear division.
FY27 consolidated revenue growth guided at low double-digit, with EBITDA margin held at last year's level.
call_points.versus_prior: new: no FY27 guidance in memory, which recorded guidance withheld in April

call_points.text: FY30 revenue target of ₹5,000 Cr retained, called challenging but achievable.
Gear division EBITDA margin guided at about 24%; MHE at 22-24% for the year.
Gear order book ₹1,050 Cr, of which ₹160 Cr is scheduled beyond FY27.
MHE margin decline split: about 2.5-3% input cost, 3% sales mix, rest lower throughput.
Q1 and Q2 seen as high input-cost quarters; order conversion slowed as customers revalidate quotes.
European market recovery expected to take at least two quarters.
Open order book stood at ₹1,292 Cr as of March 31, 2026, providing revenue visibility.
Management withheld quantitative guidance for FY27 due to geopolitical uncertainties.
